related_work_summary.relevance: Theoretical prediction of photovoltaic Hall effect in graphene via Floquet mechanism; circularly polarized light opens gap in Dirac cone
related_work_summary.key_findings: Floquet formalism applied to graphene, predicting gap opening and Hall current under circularly polarized light

related_work_summary.relevance: First experimental observation of Floquet-Bloch states on TI surface via tr-ARPES; key methodological reference
related_work_summary.key_findings: Mid-IR pump (120 meV) creates replica bands separated by ℏω; polarization-dependent band gaps at avoided crossings; LAPE ruled out by polarization analysis
comparison_axes: Polarization dependence distinguishes Floquet from LAPE

related_work_summary.relevance: First-principles calculations of Floquet-Weyl states in 3D Dirac materials; validates Floquet engineering concept
related_work_summary.key_findings: Circularly polarized light can switch between Weyl, Dirac, and TI states; demonstrates ultrafast topological switching

related_work_summary.relevance: Theory of Floquet band formation in graphene pump-probe; directly relevant to our experiment
related_work_summary.key_findings: Short optical pulses create local spectral gaps and Floquet sidebands in graphene; pseudospin texture changes at level crossings; tr-ARPES can track Floquet band formation on fs timescales
comparison_axes: Gap opening at Dirac point for circular polarization

additional_baselines_from_related_work: LAPE (laser-assisted photoemission) - must be ruled out as alternative explanation
Volkov final state mechanism - key distinction from simple Floquet-Bloch picture
